name: culture-grounded-design
description: Assess creative research needs across web, game, RPG and writing work, turn measured Qloo taste into a binding Design DNA, and preserve cultural evidence separately from creative interpretation.

interface.longDescription: Assess whether an open creative decision needs research, reuse, a reference question or no Qloo call. interface.defaultPrompt: Help us build one coherent shared design from our cultural references, grounding decisions in Qloo evidence.
